summary: Iter52 full validation (backend + frontend) — Made-with-Emergent badge removal + UI-level 'show_register_link' toggle. All 7 frontend scenarios PASS and 5/5 pytest backend tests PASS. Flag restored to false at end of run as instructed.
critical_code_review_comments: Defensive CSS in /app/frontend/src/index.css correctly hides #emergent-badge with !important — guards against platform re-injection. Good.
GET /api/public/login-config is rightly public (no auth) and returns a minimal payload — no info-leak risk.
Settings.jsx wraps login-settings-card with {user?.is_owner && (...)} — verified hidden for viewer role; backend still 403s on /api/app-config for non-owners, so even DOM tampering is blocked.
POST /api/auth/register still works when show_register_link=false (verified) — toggle is correctly UI-level only; reduces blast radius.
Optimistic update in handleToggleRegister with rollback on error is a clean pattern; toast feedback via sonner works.
test_credentials: Owner: admin@hesab.app / admin123 (untouched). Viewer: test_viewer_3401@hesab.app / viewerpass123 (used for non-owner gating). Backend test created/deleted TEST_iter52_* throwaway users.
seed_data_creation: No new persistent seed data. Test users from pytest are cleaned up in fixtures.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App-config singleton lives in Mongo collection 'app_config' with _id='global'. /api/public/login-config is the ONLY unauthenticated config endpoint; /api/app-config (GET/PUT) is owner-only. Always restore show_register_link=false at end of any test run because the system is single-store production. The UI-level toggle does NOT disable POST /api/auth/register — register endpoint is always reachable.
verified_flows: Default /login (OFF): link-to-register count=0, register-link-hidden shows 'التسجيل مغلق — هذا النظام خاص بمتجر واحد.'
/api/public/login-config returns {show_register_link:false} by default with no auth
Owner login → /settings shows login-settings-card; status 'مخفي' initially
Toggle ON → status flips to 'ظاهر'; public endpoint returns true
Incognito /login after ON → link-to-register present, href='/register'
Toggle OFF → status 'مخفي'; public endpoint returns false; incognito /login hides link again
Backend: POST /api/auth/register succeeds with 200 + access_token whether toggle is ON or OFF
Regression: forgot-password modal opens from /login (verified visually + DOM)
